Team — forwarding ConcertAI's report. Key asks: quick triage, mitigation options we can apply without an RC (customer expects update before 13:00 PT), and product-level asks if this requires any short-term config changes or roadmap items.

Initial context from customer: p95 ~1.8s, throughput ~30% down, model reported: redwood/open-medium-quant. They included request IDs and Grafana alert.

Product questions to consider quickly:
- Can we pin this customer to a non-quantized variant for a rolling mitigation? Risk/ETA?
- Any recent routing/kernel changes rolled this morning (between 07:00-09:00 PT)?
- Is KV cache eviction visible on their tenant? If so, could temporary cache-TTL changes help?

Immediate mitigations I want in scope (please respond inline with owners and ETA):
1) Short-term customer-facing mitigation (e.g., pin to open-medium float variant or route to dedicated pool) — owner/ETA
2) SRE mitigation (e.g., scale worker pool, restart affected nodes, bump batch window) — owner/ETA
3) Product/roadmap note if there's a recurring root cause (quant kernels scheduling, eviction patterns) — owner/ETA

Related links: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/incident/CON-7842 (customer screenshot attached).

Thanks — Jordan

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: ConcertAI - sudden p95 spike and throughput drop on /v1/generate

Quick triage notes (observed 08:52-09:20 PT):
- We see a spike in KV cache misses on pool gpu-pool-a (worker set w/ quant kernels). Miss rate jumped ~8x for tenant cst_concert_01 — correlates with increased tail latency.
- Several nodes in that pool are running a recent quant kernel schedule (kernel v2.1-q) which shows higher lock contention under certain sequence-length distribution.
- Autoscaler kept QPS at same capacity, but effective concurrency dropped due to longer token times => throughput reduction.

Immediate mitigations I recommend now (I can execute 20-30m):
A) Pin ConcertAI's route to redwood/open-medium-fp (non-quant) in the routing config as an emergency rollback. Impact: +6% cost, p95 should return to baseline. Owner: Soojin — ETA 25m.
B) For pool stability, recycle 3 nodes showing highest CPU wait to clear potential kernel scheduling lockups. Owner: Marcus — ETA 30m.
C) Increase per-tenant batch_window_ms for ConcertAI from 10ms to 30ms to allow more efficient batching while we stabilize. Owner: Priyom — ETA 15m (config change).

Longer-term: Engineering should triage kernel v2.1-q schedule for contention patterns and consider fallbacks to kernel v2.0 for mixed workloads. Product: priory for quant kernel hardening.

I'll implement A and C now unless someone calls out concerns. Will post updates to the thread and to the Grafana incident link.

-Soojin

- Marcus

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-23T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: ConcertAI status update — interim mitigation & next steps

Hi Lucia — quick update from our side: thank you for the alert and the sample IDs. We identified a spike in KV cache misses on the worker pool serving your tenant which, combined with a recent quant-kernel scheduling behavior, produced the p95 increase and throughput drop.

Immediate actions we applied (in past 30m):
- Pinned your route to redwood/open-medium-fp (non-quant) to remove kernel contention (SRE implemented).
- Recycled three noisy nodes in the serving pool; those nodes are reporting improved token processing times.
- Bumped your per-tenant batch_window_ms from 10 -> 30 to help throughput while we stabilize.

Expected impact: p95 should revert close to previous baseline within ~15-30 minutes. There is a small cost delta (+~6%) for using the FP variant temporarily.

Next steps (internal): SRE will monitor the Grafana dashboard and revert pin when quant-kernel fixes are validated. Product will add an automated rollback detection flag (KV-miss + token spike) to the roadmap (ETA: 2 sprints for initial flag).

Would you like us to keep the FP pin in place until your weekly sync at 13:00 PT? If yes, we will document the change on your account and provide a short post-mortem after the condition is stable.

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll stay on this until it’s fully resolved.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
